/**
 * Built-in Pi MCP bridge — turns each server in `mcp.json` into pi tools.
 *
 * NOT imported by routekit-eval's runtime: it ships inside harness-pi and is loaded by the
 * spawned `pi` binary via `--extension <path>`, in pi's own module graph. So it
 * is PLAIN TypeScript (typebox + `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`), NOT Effect. Those
 * packages are devDependencies (routekit-eval typechecks against the real APIs); at runtime
 * pi loads this via jiti, resolving `typebox` from its virtual modules and the
 * SDK from a materialized `node_modules` sibling (mirroring web-tools). This file
 * plus its `mcp-config.ts` sibling are embedded byte-for-byte as `.ts.txt` twins
 * and materialized side-by-side; the only cross-module import allowed is the
 * relative `./mcp-config.ts` one below (jiti resolves it from the materialized
 * file). Both twins are guarded by `mcp-extension.embed.test.ts`.
 *
 * Per-server connect is timeout-guarded and best-effort: a slow/misconfigured
 * server is logged and skipped, never blocking boot. Each MCP tool becomes a pi
 * tool `<server>__<tool>`; result content is projected onto pi's text/image-only
 * shape, and an MCP `isError` result is re-thrown (pi has no `isError` field).
 */

import type {
  AgentToolResult,
  ExtensionAPI,
} from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";
import type { Client } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js";
import type {
  StdioClientTransport,
  StdioServerParameters,
} from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/stdio.js";
import type { StreamableHTTPClientTransport } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/streamableHttp.js";
import type { Transport } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/shared/transport.js";
import type {
  CallToolResult,
  ContentBlock,
  EmbeddedResource,
  Tool,
} from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/types.js";

import { setTimeout as delay } from "node:timers/promises";

// `typebox`'s root (`Type`) is virtualized by pi, so it is safe to import
// statically. The `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` client classes are a
// runtime-installed sibling, so they are imported dynamically in `register`: a
// failed install degrades to "no MCP tools" instead of crashing pi's module
// evaluation (mirrors web-tools' lazy `@routekit-eval/gateway-agent` import).
import { Type } from "typebox";

import type { McpServer } from "./mcp-config.ts";

import { expandEnvRecord, isPlainRecord, readMcpConfig } from "./mcp-config.ts";

const EXTENSION_VERSION = "0.1.0";
const CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;
const EMPTY_OBJECT_SCHEMA = { type: "object" } as const;

type PiContent = AgentToolResult<null>["content"][number];

// The bridge reads only `content` + `isError`, so it uses a minimal result
// shape (the full `CallToolResult` has optional fields the empty arm can't
// satisfy under exactOptionalPropertyTypes). `content` reuses the SDK type.
interface McpToolResult {
  readonly content: CallToolResult["content"];
  readonly isError?: boolean;
}

// The MCP client surface this bridge uses; `makeClient` adapts the real
// `Client`, tests inject a fake.
interface McpClient {
  connect(): Promise<void>;
  listTools(): Promise<{ readonly tools: readonly Tool[] }>;
  callTool(request: {
    readonly name: string;
    readonly arguments?: Record<string, unknown>;
  }): Promise<McpToolResult>;
  close(): Promise<void>;
}

// The dynamically-loaded SDK client pieces; a load failure is treated as "no
// MCP tools" rather than a module-eval crash.
interface McpDeps {
  readonly Client: typeof Client;
  readonly StdioClientTransport: typeof StdioClientTransport;
  readonly StreamableHTTPClientTransport: typeof StreamableHTTPClientTransport;
  readonly getDefaultEnvironment: () => Record<string, string>;
}

const loadMcpDeps = async (): Promise<McpDeps> => {
  const [clientMod, stdioMod, httpMod] = await Promise.all([
    import("@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js"),
    import("@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/stdio.js"),
    import("@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/streamableHttp.js"),
  ]);
  return {
    Client: clientMod.Client,
    StdioClientTransport: stdioMod.StdioClientTransport,
    StreamableHTTPClientTransport: httpMod.StreamableHTTPClientTransport,
    getDefaultEnvironment: stdioMod.getDefaultEnvironment,
  };
};

// Best-effort cleanup sink (`() => {}` trips no-empty-function; this returns).
const ignoreRejection = (): undefined => undefined;

const toRecord = (params?: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | undefined =>
  isPlainRecord(params) ? params : undefined;

const embeddedResourceText = (resource: EmbeddedResource["resource"]): string =>
  "text" in resource
    ? `${resource.uri}\n\n${resource.text}`
    : `[binary resource omitted: ${resource.uri}]`;

// pi content is text/image only, so audio/resource/resource_link are projected
// to text rather than dropped.
const textContent = (text: string): PiContent => ({
  type: "text",
  text,
});

const mapContentBlock = (block: ContentBlock): PiContent => {
  switch (block.type) {
    case "text": {
      return textContent(block.text);
    }
    case "image": {
      return {
        type: "image",
        data: block.data,
        mimeType: block.mimeType,
      };
    }
    case "audio": {
      return textContent(`[audio content omitted: ${block.mimeType}]`);
    }
    case "resource": {
      return textContent(embeddedResourceText(block.resource));
    }
    case "resource_link": {
      return textContent(`[resource: ${block.name} <${block.uri}>]`);
    }
    default: {
      return textContent("[unsupported MCP content]");
    }
  }
};

const mapContent = (content: readonly ContentBlock[]): PiContent[] =>
  content.map(mapContentBlock);

const mcpErrorText = (content: readonly ContentBlock[]): string => {
  const text = content
    .filter(
      (b): b is Extract<ContentBlock, { type: "text" }> => b.type === "text"
    )
    .map((b) => b.text)
    .join("\n");
  return text.length > 0 ? text : "MCP tool returned an error";
};

const withTimeout = async <T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms: number): Promise<T> => {
  // Promise-native timer (no hand-rolled `new Promise`); the AbortController
  // clears the pending timer in `finally`.
  const abort = new AbortController();
  const timeout = delay(ms, undefined, { signal: abort.signal }).then(() => {
    throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms}ms`);
  });
  try {
    return await Promise.race([promise, timeout]);
  } finally {
    abort.abort();
  }
};

// Only `registerTool` is used, so the seam accepts the narrow slice: a fully
// typed fake in tests needs no `as` cast to satisfy it.
type ToolSink = Pick<ExtensionAPI, "registerTool">;

interface RegisterOptions {
  readonly pi: ToolSink;
  readonly serverName: string;
  // A thunk, not a built client. `makeClient` constructs the transport eagerly
  // (`new URL(server.url)`, `new StdioClientTransport(...)`), any of which can
  // throw synchronously. Deferring construction into `registerMcpServer`'s try
  // makes register()'s "each call catches internally" invariant hold for a
  // construction throw too, not just a connect failure — one bad server can
  // never abort the parallel map over its siblings.
  readonly createClient: () => McpClient;
  readonly timeoutMs?: number;
}

// The body of every registered tool's `execute`, extracted so the arg-narrowing
// + isError-throw path is unit-testable without fabricating pi's heavy
// ExtensionContext (which its ToolDefinition.execute signature demands).
const runToolCall = async (
  client: McpClient,
  toolName: string,
  params: unknown
): Promise<AgentToolResult<null>> => {
  const args = toRecord(params);
  // Omit `arguments` when empty: exactOptionalPropertyTypes rejects a
  // present-but-undefined optional key.
  const result = await client.callTool(
    args === undefined
      ? { name: toolName }
      : {
          name: toolName,
          arguments: args,
        }
  );
  if (result.isError === true) {
    // Throw so pi's execute catch marks the call failed; pi's result has no
    // isError field to set.
    throw new TypeError(mcpErrorText(result.content));
  }
  return {
    content: mapContent(result.content),
    details: null,
  };
};

const registerMcpServer = async (options: RegisterOptions): Promise<void> => {
  const {
    pi,
    serverName,
    createClient,
    timeoutMs = CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS,
  } = options;
  // Undefined until construction succeeds, so a `createClient` throw leaves the
  // catch with nothing to close.
  let client: McpClient | undefined;
  try {
    client = createClient();
    const connected = client;
    // One timeout bounds connect + listTools so a hung server can't block boot.
    const listed = connected.connect().then(() => connected.listTools());
    const { tools } = await withTimeout(listed, timeoutMs);
    for (const tool of tools) {
      pi.registerTool({
        name: `${serverName}__${tool.name}`,
        label: tool.name,
        description: tool.description ?? "",
        parameters: Type.Unsafe(tool.inputSchema ?? EMPTY_OBJECT_SCHEMA),
        execute: (_toolCallId, params) =>
          runToolCall(connected, tool.name, params),
      });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // Best-effort: one server's failure never blocks boot or sibling tools.
    // ExtensionAPI exposes no register-time logger, so pi captures this stderr line.
    console.warn(`mcp server ${serverName} unavailable: ${String(error)}`);
    // A connect that started then timed out/failed can leave a half-open client
    // (a spawned stdio child, an open HTTP transport). Close it so a slow or
    // misconfigured server does not leak a subprocess for the rest of the turn.
    await client?.close().catch(ignoreRejection);
  }
};

const makeTransport = (deps: McpDeps, server: McpServer): Transport => {
  if (server.type === "stdio") {
    const params: StdioServerParameters = { command: server.command };
    if (server.args !== undefined) {
      params.args = server.args;
    }
    if (server.env !== undefined) {
      // Merge OVER the SDK's inherited env: a set `params.env` makes the SDK
      // skip getDefaultEnvironment(), so PATH would be lost and npx/node
      // could not spawn.
      params.env = {
        ...deps.getDefaultEnvironment(),
        ...expandEnvRecord(server.env),
      };
    }
    return new deps.StdioClientTransport(params);
  }
  const http = new deps.StreamableHTTPClientTransport(
    new URL(server.url),
    server.headers === undefined
      ? undefined
      : { requestInit: { headers: expandEnvRecord(server.headers) } }
  );
  // SDK 1.29.0 type bug: StreamableHTTPClientTransport's `sessionId` getter is
  // `string | undefined`, which its own `Transport` interface (`sessionId?:
  // string`) rejects under exactOptionalPropertyTypes — no cast-free path.
  // The assertion is scoped off for this file in oxlint.config.ts.
  return http as unknown as Transport;
};

// callTool's union arms carry an `unknown` index signature, so `"content" in
// raw` alone leaves `raw.content` as `unknown`. An array guard recovers the
// SDK's content type cast-free; the legacy `{ toolResult }` arm yields empty.
const isContentArray = (value: unknown): value is CallToolResult["content"] =>
  Array.isArray(value);

const normalizeCallToolResult = (
  raw: Awaited<ReturnType<Client["callTool"]>>
): McpToolResult =>
  isContentArray(raw.content)
    ? {
        content: raw.content,
        isError: raw.isError === true,
      }
    : { content: [] };

const makeClient = (
  deps: McpDeps,
  serverName: string,
  server: McpServer
): McpClient => {
  const client = new deps.Client({
    name: `routekit-eval-${serverName}`,
    version: EXTENSION_VERSION,
  });
  const transport = makeTransport(deps, server);
  return {
    connect: () => client.connect(transport),
    listTools: () => client.listTools(),
    callTool: (request) =>
      client.callTool(request).then(normalizeCallToolResult),
    close: () => client.close(),
  };
};

// pi loads extensions via a default-export factory (`jiti.import(path, {
// default: true })`); `import/no-default-export` is scoped off for this file in
// oxlint.config.ts.
export default async function register(pi: ExtensionAPI): Promise<void> {
  const config = await readMcpConfig();
  if (config === undefined) {
    return;
  }
  // Load the SDK here, not at module top: a failed install contributes no tools
  // rather than crashing pi's module evaluation.
  let deps: McpDeps;
  try {
    deps = await loadMcpDeps();
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn(`mcp extension could not load its SDK: ${String(error)}`);
    return;
  }
  // Connect servers in parallel; each call catches internally — including a
  // synchronous client-construction throw — so this never rejects.
  await Promise.all(
    Object.entries(config.mcpServers).map(([name, server]) =>
      registerMcpServer({
        pi,
        serverName: name,
        createClient: () => makeClient(deps, name, server),
      })
    )
  );
}

export const __testing = {
  mapContent,
  normalizeCallToolResult,
  registerMcpServer,
  runToolCall,
  toRecord,
};
export type { McpClient, McpToolResult };
